description.value: Ukee Peninsula Motel is a newly renovated 19-room motel on the rugged west coast of Vancouver Island, situated between Pacific Rim National Park Reserve and the Broken Group Islands. Rooms range from accessible king suites to kitchenette units accommodating up to four guests, all on a private-entrance property with free parking. Its central Ucluelet location puts it within walking distance of local restaurants, making it a convenient overnight base for cyclists exploring the Pacific Rim.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and substantive, confirming the motel's address, phone, and room details. Free Wi-Fi is explicitly stated in every room description ('free wifi'), and the Explore section states 'All restaurants are walking distance to the lodge except #8 (10 min walk)', confirming nearby evening food. No mention of bike storage, laundry, or cycling-specific services appears anywhere on the site; the website also contains injected spam content (online casino ads, AI essay-tool links) that is unrelated to the motel.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; phone (250) 726-7751 sourced from website only.

Website contains injected third-party spam: online casino promotions (Betonred, Casino Nine Brasil, MostBet Portugal) and an AI essay-writing tool link embedded within page body copy — indicates the site's CMS or a plugin may have been compromised.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active motel with a functioning website, online booking system, recently renovated rooms (2024), and confirmed contact details. A clear and useful overnight stop for touring cyclists in Ucluelet.
